pick.headline: Israel extends its law to the Golan Heights
pick.summary: On 14 December 1981 the Knesset passed the Golan Heights Law, applying Israeli law and administration to the territory captured from Syria in 1967.
pick.significance: The effective annexation led the Reagan administration to suspend a newly signed strategic cooperation agreement with Israel.

alternates.headline: Bosnian peace agreement signed in Paris
alternates.summary: On 14 December 1995 the leaders of Bosnia, Croatia and Serbia formally signed the Dayton peace agreement in Paris.
alternates.significance: The signing ended the Bosnian war and handed peacekeeping to a NATO-led force including US troops.
